Damian Betebenner is a Senior Associate at the [National Center for the Improvement of Educational
Assessment](https://www.nciea.org) (the Center for Assessment). He developed the student growth percentile (SGP)
methodology and maintains the open-source [SGP](https://dbetebenner.github.io/SGP/) R package, which states use to
calculate and report student growth. His work with state education agencies spans growth and accountability
systems, technical advisory committees, and the reporting of results to educators and the public.

## This site

Talks are listed from a single catalog built from the original slide files and the Quarto repositories they were
published in. Recent decks stay at their original addresses, because QR codes on the slides point there.

The site uses the [dataimago](https://github.com/dataimago/dataimago-design) design system, with self-hosted fonts and
light and dark themes. If anything here is inaccessible to you, please
[open an issue](https://github.com/dbetebenner/dbetebenner.github.io/issues).
